pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pFuel-burning light source that contributes carbon to Basic/Advanced Greenhouses.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Put ordinary furnace fuel in the lantern.$p2. Place it within the greenhouse’s eligible space.$p3. Keep it burning and observe greenhouse carbon over time.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pThe item’s registry ID says off because active state controls its lighting. A spent lantern cannot provide ongoing carbon.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
